map.方法一（放大率法）：\n 实际牙长 = X线测得牙长 ÷ (1 + 放大率)\:
Method 1 (magnification):
  real tooth length = X-ray length / (1 + magnification)

Method 2 (file-insertion):
  real tooth length = initial file depth + X-ray apical remainder / (1 + magnification)

Working length WL = real tooth length - distance from stop to apex - safety margin

map.输入：片上牙长 22mm，放大率 1.1，根尖止点距根尖 0.5mm\n计算：实:
Input: film tooth length 22mm, magnification 1.1, stop 0.5mm from apex
Calculation: real length = 22 / 1.1 = 20mm; working length WL = 20 - 0.5 = 19.5mm
Note: actually determined by electronic apex locator combined with film.
map.X 线有放大，片测长度偏大；除以放大率得真实牙长，避免工作长度偏长导致超充或偏短: X-ray has magnification, so film-measured length is too large; dividing by magnification gives the real length, avoiding overfill from too-long or underfill from too-short working length.
map.根尖止点设在哪里？: Where to set the apical stop?
map.通常止于距解剖根尖 0.5~1mm 的根尖狭窄区，兼顾清理与窄小封闭；以电子根尖: Usually at the apical constriction 0.5-1mm from the anatomical apex, balancing cleaning and tight sealing; assisted by electronic apex locator.
map.能代替根尖定位仪吗？: Can it replace the apex locator?
map.不能。本工具为片测估算，临床以电子根尖定位仪结合片确定工作长度，由牙体牙髓科医师: No. This tool is a film-estimate; clinically the working length is set by electronic apex locator combined with film, operated by an endodontist.
